texts.s: Conjecture (tested by a width scan, H21):
a network narrower than the latent
Measured: flow-matching loss of the plain
models W0, W4, W4s after training
potentials models: 2 to 3 times too many
Four remedies on the same glyphs
exact Gaussian field + learned affine correction + network
Gaussian law per mode, no network
The Gaussian law alone is the closest in energy distance; the models with a learned
affine term have fewer spurious null points and half its restart drift.
